name: calendar
description: Native guidance for date selection with DatePicker in graphical style and MultiDatePicker for several dates.
docs: Use `DatePicker` with `.datePickerStyle(.graphical)` for a calendar and `MultiDatePicker` for several dates. Both inherit tint, locale, calendar, and layout direction; the registry adds no replacement calendar.
accessibility: Native date pickers expose adjustable day cells and month navigation to VoiceOver.
Locale, first weekday, and right-to-left month order come from the environment.
Keep a visible label; the graphical style hides it, so provide surrounding context.
